name: ARX Equity Partners
decision_note: Prague-headquartered mid-market buyout/succession private equity firm (MBO/MBI, majority stakes); real and active (Medicofit, Aug 2026) but not VC, so outside the cz-vc pilot.

evidence.quote: With more than € 300 million raised in four funds, ARX has become a leading private equity firm in its segment operating in the Central European (“CE”) region.
Headquartered or primarily operating in the CE region.
a leading Central European private equity firm, today announced the acquisition of a majority stake in Medicofit, fizioterapija d.o.o.

analyst_notes: Quick S1 dossier. Capital = 'more than EUR 300 million raised in four funds' (cumulative, a lower bound) from an undated About page; as_of set to the retrieval date. Target companies are valued EUR 10-50m with EBITDA >= EUR 1m (working-with-arx page); no per-deal equity ticket stated, the CVCA profile (class D, 2020) says EUR 5-50m total transaction size. Other 2026 deals on the site: Direct4me (2026-03-17), HLB PROXY majority stake (2026-01-30). Site footer names the ARX IV Fund (EU COSME Equity Facility for Growth support); its fund vehicle was not identified in ARES.
